newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel weak below top of gap at 128.52.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel weak below top of gap at 128.52.

text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF will seek to reach up to 128.52 on Monday and fill the gap from Friday's low to the open this session, but overall the contract is weak, technical analysts said.
The contract partially filled the gap in early trade, building to 128.44 from an opening level of 128.38.
By 0745 GMT June notionnel had slipped to 128.28, down 0.42. The market has been damaged by political uncertainty.
"The contract is managing to hold in at the moment, but I supsect later on see further downside," said Jim Dodgin, technical analyst at Technical Data in London.
"All the daily studies look bearish and we could well see a retest of 128.04, last Monday's low," Dodgin said. "If we get through there then the recent rally is certainly dead and buried."
The contract rallied from 127.06 in early April to 128.84 last Thursday.
Dodgin said to get back into bull mode the gap would need to be filled.
"That would begin to ease the downward pressure, but you would really have to get above 129.06 before you could start calling it a buy," he said.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, said he did not see the notionnel climbing beyond 128.50/52.
"As a projected range for today 128.00 to 128.50 doesn't look unreasonable," he said.
If it got down through 128.00, Wood said the contract would look very soft.
"Something would have to be out of kilter for it to get below 128.00 today, because then you are looking at 127.66 and the lows around 127.00," he said.
At the short end, June Pibor futures were at 96.33, down 16 basis points on the day.
